notes.title: Patch 1.0.2b - Portuguese added
notes.content:
Hello!

With this minor patch we just added Portuguese translation to the game!

Thank you!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2a
notes.content:
Hello!

It seems there was an issue with one of the maps in Legendary mode that made the UI unresponsive.
We fixed the issue and all the affected saves should get back to normal.

Happy holidays!

notes.title: New Mode: Legendary
notes.content:
Hello!

With version 1.0.2 we introduce a new game mode!

[b]Legendary Mode:[/b]
A mode for longer game runs so you can be able to build larger and even more epic cities.
[list]
[*] This mode uses larger maps, so you have enough space to build everything you want.
[*] Architect Shop: You can now easily unlock buildings as long as you have some extra gold...
[*] You will be able to unlock more buildings than regular mode so you can chose more styled buildings and wonders
[*] While you can still achieve victories in this game mode, it is recommended you continue playing to build the city as big as you want.
[/list]

Let us know if you find any issues or suggestions as we are still trying out new things with this new mode.

Thank you!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello!
With this small patch we fixed some issues and started the work for some new updates coming in the future.

A reminder that if you achieve a victory in a save game you can continue playing, but will not be able to achieve any other victory with the same city.

[list]
[*] Diplomacy should be working as expected in the regular mode
[*] Major revision of all Wonders and fix multiple small and big issues on them
[*] Cozy mode will no longer trigger some specific negative events.
[*] Bath house max population capacity increased
[*] Great House of Healing should give the max population capacity as described
[*] Arcology and other wonders now give the correct bonus
[*] Improved some text visibility issues
[*] Other minor fixes
[/list]

If you have any issues with the victory conditions let us know in the forums.

We have plans to improve Creative mode and add a new mode that is more challenging and long.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.0c
notes.content:
Minor fixes for some reported issues:

[list]
[*] Fixed Goddess of Culture and other misbehaving buildings
[*] You will no longer encounter combat in Cozy Mode
[*] The Expedition event sometimes would not work correctly
[*] Fixed some missing elements from the German translation.
[/list]

Thank you for the feedback!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.0a
notes.content:
Fixing an important issue:

[list]
[*] The first mission should complete normally now!
[*] Fixed some UI issues on tooltips
[/list]

Thanks for the feedback!

notes.title: Diplomatic Update
notes.content:
The Diplomatic Update is now live!

These are the main features:
[list]
[*] Diplomatic Tab: You can now see your diplomatic relations with the neighboring city states. Certain events will trigger when a city state is very unhappy with you or when you are friendly allies.
[*] Building Manager: Easier to manage the active buildings in just one place.
[*] New Goddess Statues that will help your city in specific areas according to your needs.
[*] New pleasant music tracks
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40058402/2ece4ad683980d55a7d650e4c2c962205281db47.png[/img]

These new features will pave the way to add more buildings and deeper mechanics in the next update.

Other changes:
[list]
[*] Improved behavior of the UI
[*] Increased output of stone producing buildings
[*] The Siege event is now triggered by the city states, so you can avoid them if you use the right words, or gold...
[*] New balances for mid to end game.
[*] Libraries are now more useful and increase rare building drops.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.8.7 Update!
notes.content:
It's time for a new update, introducing the 'sapphire' architectural style and some important changes.
This update will also prepare for the changes in the upcoming big 'Diplomatic Update'.

The new architectural style features buildings that give 2 types of resources.
In this example the [b]Garden Farm[/b] gives food production and also culture:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40058402/c5a6b2a0d1b2819f53bebe8b656f498206154c0d.gif[/img]

We also have been working on big UI changes, for now the scale is smaller and there has been some UX improvements. But this is just the beginning as we plan to do more improvements in the next updates.

Here is the change list:
[list]
[*] A new architectural style featuring 7 new buildings
[*] Game speed reduced so the mid to late game is less chaotic
[*] It's now easier and faster to unlock more wonders 
[*] The whole UI is smaller now and should fit more things and be more clear.
[*] There are UI improvements in several places but even more UI improvements are coming later
[*] Starting game food storage is increased on both modes
[*] Many other game balances to the mid to late gameplay
[*] Other small bug fixes
[/list]

Thank you everyone for your support, the next content update should come out early next month.

notes.title: New content update
notes.content:
Hello builders!

This is yet another content update, introducing new building variations with another architecture style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40058402/9eb4caa23dd67596abc444e92136938d0ee6ef4b.gif[/img]

With this addition we have now more than 200 unique buildings in the game.

Here is the change log:

[list]
[*] Fixed a reported issue with the siege event
[*] Added the 9 new styled variations of existing buildings
[*] Added a new wonder, the Grand Bazaar!
[*] Other minor fixes
[/list]

The Diplomacy Update will take a bit longer and we expect it to arrive during September.
But there will be smaller content updates releasing before.

Thank you everyone!

notes.title: Patch 0.8.3
notes.content:
Hello!
We fixed the recent achievement issue, so the achievements should fire correctly.

And if you have finished a game recently and didn't get any achievement, just try to launch the game and it should fetch you the most recent achievements you got!

Patch notes:
[list]
[*] Achievement issue
[*] The 'city full of wonders' victory will only be reached now if you own 5 wonders instead of 4
[*] Other minor issues
[/list]

Thank you!

notes.title: Small Update v0.8.2
notes.content:
Hello!

First, the promised update for May called 'Diplomacy Update' will be delayed to June or July.
This will give us more time to implement and test some big changes to the game.

But we will instead release small updates in the coming weeks.

For today's update:
[list]
[*] New Wonder: [b]Great Fountain[/b] inspired in the Italian Fontana di Trevi
[*] New Building: [b]Water Market[/b]
[*] Balances: The raider events, in the regular mode, are now less agressive
[*] The stone resources now have more stone! Only works for new games
[*] Other minor fixes
[/list]

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: The 'War Update' patch
notes.content:
The War Update was released last week and today we launch a minor fix with some balance changes and other things.

[list]
[*] The Siege event now only triggers later in the game.
[*] The Siege event will now take a longer time between waves and difficulty has been lowered.
[*] Added 11 new decoration buildings. You can check all of them in creative mode.
[*] Other minor fixes
[/list]
When you have a Barracks building you will automatically train at least 1 soldier per turn. 
For that you will need 1 metal, 1 gold and 1 population.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40058402/ee048b010cfb6314015090c752ee5cfc9e261fb4.png[/img]

You will need soldiers to defend yourself against raiders, that can arrive via boat or horseback.

There are plenty of things that we will fine tune the next few weeks according to player feedback.

In [b]cozy mode[/b] there wont be any siege or raider events, but you can still build Barracks and train soldiers if you want.

In the next big update called 'Diplomatic Update' we will add more features that will give more uses to your defensive buildings.

Thank you!

notes.title: The 'War Update' is now Live!
notes.content:
The 'War Update' is now live!
We'll post more details about this update, but here goes a quick change list:

[i](These new buildings and features will not be available in 'cozy mode')[/i]

[list]
[*] You can now train soldiers, for this you will need to unlock and build the 'Barracks' building
[*] There are 2 new Barracks buildings where you can train and give housing to your soldiers
[*] 4 new defensive tower buildings that increase your soldiers effectiveness
[*] 1 New wonder, the Great Castle that provides even more soldiers and defensive stats
[*] New horse back raiders and other updated events
[*] Siege Event: If these event shows up, it means a foreign power will start a siege! You will have to defend your city or risk total defeat!
[*] Some reported issues have been fixed
[/list]

That is all for now, thank you!

notes.title: The Explorers Update
notes.content:
The new Explorers Update is now live!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40058402/2336fc03963cf3956b6addae09e2a56e8c75ec3e.png[/img]

Launch and expedition into the unkown seas to find new lands and riches.
But to achieve this victory you will need a sizable population and build a dry dock to be able to construct a Caravel and explore the great seas.

[list]
[*] New Expedition Victory
[*] 3 New Wonders: Grand Sun Pyramid, Temple of Awakening and Sea Fortress
[*] New building: Dry Dock (required for the expedition victory)
[*] Culture changes, now the max caps to receive a reward from culture points will increase according to your population size
[*] Several fixes and improvements suggested by the community
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40058402/10fa6c0275487e15368d853201c8e09e2ff8560c.png[/img]

There is also a new roadmap incoming!
We will have 2 big content updates before the final 1.0 release!

So expect LakeSide to launch out of early access this summer!

Thank you everyone.

notes.title: Patch 0.7.2
notes.content:
Hello!
We've fixed some issues, so here it goes:

[list]
[*] You can right click to cancel a current selection/action
[*] When you finish a cultural victory, the victory icon is displayed correctly, in the score tab
[*] Fixed the Grand Colossus wonder. It now gives the bonus correctly and stops giving 'infinite' city capacity.
[*] Other minor fixes
[/list]

Thank you everyone!

notes.title: 0.7.1 - January Update
notes.content:
In 0.7.1 we added a couple new things before the next big content update that will be coming in February.

There is a new victory condition, the Cultural Victory!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40058402/b0e575429b68c173bc5d23bf7856f6e909e1b153.gif[/img]

To achieve that you will need a new building, the [b]Art Gallery[/b] that unlocks the [b]Wonder Chapel[/b]. 
With that, and enough culture output, you will achieve the victory.

So here is the list of changes:

[list]
[*] New building: Art Gallery
[*] New wonder: Wonder Chapel
[*] New music track 'Finding Balance'
[*] The 3rd tier of some buildings will now automatically unlock the first tier of that building
[*] When you unlock a more advanced tier of housing, it will unlock all the expansions of the previous tier
[*] Other minor fixes and building cost changes
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40058402/b188f0ec07f55f3692032211054987ab19c703e1.gif[/img]

The game soundtrack is also now available on bandcamp!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40058402/7da47df50b8736c611fc5d6c8f6985bdb21bb2ca.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40058402/dc229d3de46177ebfdb7cd7fabc7b800cfc3510c.jpg[/img][/url]
Made by Martyn Stonehouse you can check it here: https://martynstonehouse.bandcamp.com/album/lakeside-original-soundtrack

There is also an updated roadmap coming soon! 
Thank you!

notes.title: Content Update version 0.7.0
notes.content:
We released a new update 2 weeks ago, here is the list of changes:

[list]
[*] 3 New Wonders: Golden Temple, Forest Temple and Grand palace
[*] A new architectural style, represented by tree icon, inspired in East Asia architecture
[*] 7 new buildings with the new style
[*] Added decoration buildings. These won't affect gameplay but are a nice addition to your city
[*] New filters added to the building list
[*] Other minor bug fixes and improvements
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40058402/60146fd32cfc1bd2b07fcbd00a20c39f54866756.gif[/img]

With the start of the new year there are plenty of planned updates, from diplomacy to defensive buildings.

An updated roadmap will be revealed in the coming weeks.

Thank you for the support!

notes.title: Patch 0.6.5 - Intermediary Update
notes.content:
Hello city builders!

This is a small content update before the next big update coming in a couple of weeks.

There is a new scenario, new buildings and other small improvements:
[list]
[*] A new scenario, that has plenty of space to build and similar to the title screen art
[*] New Buildings: Blacksmith and Water Chapel
[*] Season Events now change the color of the environment, but there will be more effects in the next update.
[*] Removed the German language option because it was enabled by mistake. There are still some things left to translate but the next update should fix this.

[/list]

Thank you!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.6.2a
notes.content:
Hotfix fixing a couple of important issues:
[list]
[*] Steam achievements should be working again
[*] Fixed an issue where some buildings could disappear when you loaded a game
[*] Other minor issues
[/list]

Thank you!

notes.title: Patch 0.6.2
notes.content:
Hello!
We've fixed some important issues and added a couple of new buildings
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue with the first mission to build 3 Farms. It should work always work now!
[*] Fixed the issue when the housing got to 0 after removing some buildings.
[*] Added the Large Water Apartments and the Water Chapel
[*] Other minor fixes
[/list]

We are working on more small fixes and improving some of the UI issues, so expect more patches soon!
The next big content update will come in 1 or 2 weeks.

Thank you!

notes.title: Patch 0.6.1
notes.content:
Hello!
This is a minor patch fixing some reported bugs. 
There are some difficulty changes that will be coming next week to balance the difference between the space available in each scenario.

[list]
[*] Fixed some issues with completing the first mission
[*] The Master Architect building now has a cost

notes.title: 0.6.0 - Architectural Marvels Update is now live!
notes.content:
The latest content update is now live!

More buildings, new wonders, new events and a new mechanic.

0.6.0 'Architectural Marvels Update':

[list]
[*] 3 New Wonders: The Great Cathedral, Thunder God Temple and The Oracle
[*] 4 New Buildings
[*] New Mechanic: Make buildings with the same architectural style to gain bonuses
[*] New scenario 'Atlean Ruins': Build your city on top of ancient ruins built by an old civilization
[*] New random events
[*] Some events will appear as a notification so they wont disturb your city building!
[*] Many minor fixes, improvements and balance changes
[/list]

With these changes there will be probably more balance fixes in the coming days so the difficulty isn't drastically changed.

Thank you!

notes.title: New content update coming next week!
notes.content:
Hello builders!

A new big content update is coming next week.

We are introducing new buildings, wonders, new mechanics and improved event interactions and UI fixes.

We are also part of the Indie X event coming up later next week!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40058402/946155ba7bbb84a066af7ab47427a8c87ae207c3.gif[/img]


Thank you!

notes.title: Version 0.5.8
notes.content:
Hello!
Another small patch with some fixes and balance changes:

[list]
[*] Higher tier buildings now have a gold maintenance, other low tier buildings have been 'nerfed'
[*] Some building unlocks have been changed, some 'rare' unlocks might show more often and some building upgrades that rarely showed up should now appear more often
[*] The game should display better in 4K resolutions, 21:9 aspect ratio and should fix some visual issues on even wider ratios. But a reminder that the widest ratio supported is 21:9 
[*] 'Repair All' button is now available so you can easily repair all the affected buildings
[*] Improved UI with several minor changes
[*] Several other bug fixes
[/list]

Thank you!

notes.title: The Ancient Wonders update is now live!
notes.content:
The 'Ancient Wonders' update is now live!
Brings 3 new wonders, 7 new buildings and a new scenario with plenty of space to build.

[list]
[*] 3 New Wonders: The Colossus, The Great Lighthouse and The Statue of Prosperity
[*] 3 New special buildings, they are goddess statues dedicated to 3 elements and will make early bonuses on your city
[*] 4 New regular buildings:
[*] Outdoor Storage: A shabby storage that will be easily accessible in the early game
[*] Stilt House: Housing that can be built on water!
[*] Apartments and Large Apartments: New late game high density housing
[*] A new city scenario that gives you more building space
[*] Some small improvements to the UI
[*] Minor bugs and stats adjustments
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40058402/cfef34b179d6e23b113825bd02ddf2f884b88a35.gif[/img]

Thank you everyone!

notes.title: Version 0.5.3
notes.content:
Next week there will be a bigger content update, but for now we've decided to push some of the changes:

[list]
[*] New game mode: '[i]cozy mode[/i]' that slows down the game, removes some hostile events and makes the whole game much calm and cozy...
[*] New building animations
[*] You now get a prompt before you overwrite your current game save
[*] Other minor fixes and Ui improvements
[/list]

Next week the 'Ancient Wonders' update will bring not only fixes but new wonders, buildings and other important gameplay changes.

Thank you!

notes.title: Version 0.5.2 - Repair option, balances and more
notes.content:
Hello!
As requested, you can now click on the ruins and you will have the option to repair a building for half of the cost.

Here are other changes:

[list]
[*] Market buildings now have the gold output capped at +10.
[*] There is a new background music called 'Spring Season'!
[*] The wind and water mills have been nerfed in their food producing bonus
[*] The buildings list is now ordered. This will be improved further in a later patch.
[*] Earthquakes will only destroy a maximum of 3 buildings
[*] Some minor bugs in the UI and others
[/list]

The next update should be a bigger one, there will be a new mode called 'cozy mode' that let's you play as a cozy and relaxed as possible, while the regular mode will be the one that is available now.

Thank you everyone for the great feedback!

notes.title: Version 0.5.1 - Game speed and more fixes
notes.content:
Hello! Another day, another patch.

We have slowed down the game speed and done some adjustments that will impact the mid to late game.

[list]
[*] The speed of the game has been slowed down by 33%. This should make the game more manageable but there will be more improvements on this matter
[*] Improved the UI for the exchanges and markets
[*] Now the demolish button won't stay enabled when you open the build list
[*] Resource exchanges and markets have been 'nerfed', so they won't give so much gold
[*] The 'Grand Pyramid' costs have been increased for some of the steps
[*] Other UI improvements on resource costs
[*] A new event will show up offering a storage building in case you don't unlock one past a certain year.
[*] Other minor bugs
[/list]

There is still a lot to improve regarding UI and others, a bigger update should drop next week with not only fixes but new buildings and events.

Thank you!

notes.title: LakeSide - Small patch 0.5.0b
notes.content:
Hello!
LakeSide is out now on early access and we already got a small patch with plenty of fixes and improvements from players feedback.

[list]
[*] Sewers and House of Healing are now working as described
[*] The reward building music track sometimes started to loop, it's now fixed
[*] When you demolish a building it now shows a prompt so you can confirm what you want to destroy!
[*] Improvements in UI when demolishing and selecting certain buildings
[*] Fixed an issue where max city capacity would go up to a million
[*] Small typos and missing text
[*] Other minor bugs
[/list]

We are aware of some of the issues reported and we have a long list of things to improve and fix.
There will be a better explanation on how the unlocking of buildings work and more details on the victory conditions and requirements.

Thank you for the amazing feedback!

notes.title: LakeSide is coming soon!
notes.content:
Hello!
Let's talk about the upcoming early access release, what it brings and the weeks after that.

If everything goes as planned [b]LakeSide [/b]will be released later [b]this month![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40058402/6a24def08ecbef2cc3b18425cff331b0421574d0.gif[/img]

The early access is going to be released with some limitations but with the full game loop.
- 2 Victory Conditions
- More than 60 buildings
- 3 terrains to build your city, but more coming soon
- More than 20 unique events
- A Creative mode that allows you to build your own custom city

But a lot of content updates are planned for the weeks after the early access launch. 
We already got a lot of new buildings and events to add but need just a little more time to see how the game is balanced while people are playing it and sending feedback.

A roadmap will be available during launch so you'll know what will be coming out next.

[b]LakeSide [/b]is a city builder with resource management that can get harder as you progress and expand your city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40058402/4333730a1f0b4f5d369add88ddc917f44dcd524f.png[/img]

There is no fixed tech tree and each time you play you will receive different building rewards that you have to choose from. That means that each new game will be different and you will need to adapt to not only the available buildings but to random events that will complicate your citizen’s life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40058402/466f4196dfb691791795c0483e7bf2bfe8bff242.png[/img]

From earthquakes to wildfires or unpleasant neighbors, each time you play things will always be different.

More updates and information about the game next week!
